events.verdict: Caldwell-Pope (ORL) steps forward into Jones (CHI) at the end of his drive, but he moves through the contact and is able to make the pass.
Phillips (CHI) dislodges Wagner (ORL) from his rebounding position, which affects his ability to secure the loose ball.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the on-court ruling of basket interference by Phillips (CHI) stands as called.
Jones (CHI) makes clean contact with the ball as he dislodges it from Wagner's (ORL) possession during the drive. The contact by Giddey (CHI) prior to Jones getting his hand on the ball is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Wagner (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes OOB.
Carter Jr. (ORL) brings his arm across Phillips' (CHI) path and affects his FOM as he moves off-ball.
Carter Jr. (ORL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from White (CHI).
Although Carter Jr. (ORL) makes contact with the ball, he jumps and lands on top of White (CHI), initiating illegal contact during the loose ball.
White (CHI) makes clean contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it away from Wagner (ORL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Carter Jr. (ORL) and Buzelis (CHI) mutually engage and disengage and marginal contact occurs during the rebound as Buzelis stumbles to the ground.
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is confirmed that Carter Jr. (ORL) does not release his shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock.
